assetOrigin: Original procedural mesh, embedded PBR maps, skeleton and animation; no third-party mesh or texture inputs.

artDirection.silhouette: Compact stylized ninja with a squared, tapered head, brown short jacket, wide dark belt, indigo pants, topknot and a single right-hand wooden staff.
artDirection.face: Indigo lower-face mask, angled brows, large readable eyes and red headband; head uses a rounded-box silhouette rather than a spherical head.
artDirection.staff: Wooden shaft with dark iron caps, brass rings, bound grip and red tassel. The staff is held in the right hand; the left hand remains free.
artDirection.motion: Rest-pose-aware two-bone IK, continuous limb skinning, staff orientation driven by the right hand, coat and sash follow-through.
artDirection.gameplay: The swing clip is visual only. Draw-state visibility is controlled by char.stickDrawn; damage, hit validation and authoritative timing remain game responsibilities.

standardization.coordinateNote: No horizontal Root.position motion in any clip; walk is in place. dead rotates Root for a grounded fall without horizontal travel.

rig.type: glTF SkinnedMesh skeleton with baked TRS animation tracks
rig.staffBinding: StickPivot is a child of HandR; StickGrip is zero-offset from HandR. The independently visible stick group contains the staff mesh batch.

clips.name: idle
clips.semantic: relaxed guard with breathing, head movement and cloth follow-through

clips.name: walk
clips.semantic: in-place walk with staff carried in the right hand

clips.name: swing
clips.semantic: right-hand staff windup, horizontal sweep and recovery

clips.name: flinch
clips.semantic: hit reaction with weight shift and staff guard

clips.name: dead
clips.semantic: grounded elimination with staff attached to the right hand

clips.name: victory
clips.semantic: upright staff presentation with shoulder and cloth motion

integration.renderer: sRGB output, ACES Filmic tone mapping, optional environment and shadows
integration.runtimeRegistration: Not performed; production CharacterRig integration remains a separate task.

limitations: Polished procedural stylization, not a photorealistic scan or externally generated character.
